title: Emboss a 10x4 rectangle 1 mm round a cylinder r20 (wrapped like a label)

expect.note: Wrapped without stretch: 10 mm round = 0.5 rad, 4 mm along the axis. Boss = 0.5/2 * (21^2 - 20^2) * 4 = 41 (= area 40 * 1 * (1 + 1/(2*20))). Area: cylinder 2 pi 20 40 + 2 pi 400; boss top 21*0.5*4 = 42 replaces 20*0.5*4 = 40 (+2), two end walls 0.5/2*(441-400) = 10.25 each, two side walls 1*4 each: +30.5. Faces: 3 + top + 4 walls; edges: 2 circles + seam + 12
